description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific protection template
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-template --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 1333 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection template that you want to query
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Template.description_en: The details of the protection template

DefenseScene.description_en: The scenario in which the protection template is used. For more information, see the description of the DefenseScene parameter in the [CreateDefenseRule](~~CreateDefenseRule~~) operation
DefenseScene.description_zh: 防护场景。更多信息，请参见[CreateDefenseRule](~~CreateDefenseRule~~)的DefenseScene参数

DefenseSubScene.description_en:
The sub-scenario of the protection template. Valid values:

web: the bot management template for website protection.

app: the bot management template for app protection.

basic: the basic bot management template.

bot_custom_acl: the bot management template for custom protection rules
DefenseSubScene.description_zh:
防护模版子场景，取值：
web：表示BOT管理网页防护场景模版。
app：表示BOT管理APP防护场景模版。
basic：表示BOT管理基础防护模版。
bot_custom_acl：表示BOT管理高级自定义规则防护模版

Description.description_en: The description of the protection template
Description.description_zh: 要创建的防护模板描述信息

GmtModified.description_en: The most recent time the protection template was modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the protection template

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the protection template

TemplateOrigin.description_en: The origin of the protection template. A value of custom indicates that the template is user-defined
TemplateOrigin.description_zh: 要创建的防护模板来源。取值为custom，表示用户自定义

TemplateStatus.description_en:
The status of the protection template. Valid values:

0: disabled.

1: enabled
TemplateStatus.description_zh:
防护模板状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启

TemplateType.description_en:
The type of the protection template. Valid values:

user_default: the default template.

user_custom: a custom template
TemplateType.description_zh:
防护模板类型。取值：
user_default：表示用户默认防护。
user_custom：表示用户自定义防护
